name: TeamStarWolf - Water and Wastewater Networks (ICS)
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. The 32 ATT&CK for ICS techniques that the verified record in case-studies/WATER_TREATMENT_NETWORKS.md supports: ATT&CK campaigns C0020 and C0031, the CyberAv3ngers group record G1027, and the advisories AA21-287A and AA25-343A and AA26-097A, with AA25-343A's revoked ids T0812 and T0855 bound to their v20 successors through data/attack/superseded_by.jsonl. Scores: 100 the advisory or ATT&CK object lists the id, 40 the mapping is this study's Inferred reading. Each comment names the records and the study's source numbers.

legendItems.label: 100: the advisory or the ATT&CK object lists the id
